fixed_plan:
Fixed plan: saved-CNN input interventions, defined before execution.

Purpose: test the response of existing fitted CNN functions to actual same-target
training-feature donors. This is not a deployment method, a new generalisation
result, a physical causal experiment, or a repair of the original measurements.

All 24 required LOAO CNN checkpoints (eight acquisitions, three seeds) and their
metadata must exist before inference starts. Load using torch.load(...,
weights_only=True) only. Verify seed, training-index hash and state-file hash.
Never call train_or_load, fit_author_cnn, an optimiser, backward or spectral fit.

First reproduce all 2,457 original CNN predictions using each complete held-out
acquisition as one batch in original row order. Every row's Euclidean error
must agree with the retained CSV to <=1e-6 micrometres. Failure stops before
interventions; the tolerance is not changed to obtain a result.

For all 212 directed same-coordinate test/training-reference pairs and three
seeds, replace five prespecified groups: separation (0::3), u1 (1::3), u2 (2::3),
u1+u2, and all 24 features. The donated values are actual log features from that
fold's training observations at exactly the same target coordinate. Preserve
the target coordinates, all other feature values, all weights and every other
row in the complete held-acquisition inference batch. Report every pair and
group, including worsening outcomes, without choosing a best donor.

Partially replaced vectors are synthetic hybrids and need not be physically
realisable spectra. All-feature replacement supplies a previously seen training
input, not a newly successful held-out measurement. Interpret only network-level
input sensitivity. No physical mechanism, new validation or automatic feature
correction is established.

Aggregate errors first across donors within observation/seed/group, then across
three seeds within observation/group, then across observations within acquisition.
Report all eight acquisitions, including zero-eligible-observation acquisitions.
The overall summary gives equal weight to the five represented acquisitions;
also show the alternative 209-observation-weighted mean. Neither replaces the
original eight-acquisition/all-819-observation primary endpoint. Export every
row-563 result (two donors x three seeds x five groups) and calculate no p values.

baseline.batch_definition: Complete held-acquisition rows in original row order, same shape for baseline and each intervention

aggregation_order: average all actual same-coordinate training donors within observation and seed
equal weight for five represented acquisitions; separate observation-weighted alternative
boundaries: Model-input intervention, not physical causal attribution
Partially mixed vectors may not correspond to a real spectrum
All24 uses an actual training input, so its error is not a new held-out generalisation endpoint
No best-donor selection; worsening interventions retained
This 209-observation subset does not replace the all-819 primary results
Original MLP fold states were not all retained; no substitute MLP was trained
